datasets.title: IGAD Region - Monthly Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) 2024
datasets.description: Monthly Combined Drought Indicator (CDI) as implemented in the East Africa Drought Watch, and which is used for detecting and monitoring areas that either are affected or have the potential to be affected by meteorological, agricultural and/or hydrological drought.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/igad-region-monthly-combined-drought-indicator-cdi-2024]

contact_point.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

creator.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)

lineage.description: Monthly CDI rasters are generated by ICPAC using the East Africa Drought Watch framework, which combines multiple drought indices (meteorological, agricultural, hydrological) into a composite indicator. The 2024 monthly datasets provide spatially continuous drought hazard assessment across the IGAD region for operational drought monitoring and early warning.

sources.name: IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC)
sources.description: East Africa Drought Watch Combined Drought Indicator methodology that integrates meteorological, agricultural, and hydrological drought indices into a unified monitoring product for drought detection and early warning.
